verdict: Leads are arriving efficiently; the gap is converting them to appointments.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 122 leads from Meta at a cost of $11.90 per lead — and that cost per lead dropped a further 26% in the most recent week, which reflects higher-intent traffic reaching your ads. The problem is downstream: 81 opportunities are sitting in the pipeline with zero appointments logged and zero new patients recorded, meaning leads are arriving but not being scheduled. This is an intake issue, not an ads issue, and it is being addressed directly — phone-match attribution and contact records are being cleaned up so every lead can be traced through to a booked appointment. A full tracking dashboard goes live by August 31, which will give us a clear scoreboard from ad click to new patient for the first time.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period from paid ads
cost per lead this period, down 26% in the last week
appointments logged against those 122 leads — the intake gap being fixed now

watch_item.issue: Leads are not converting to appointments — 81 open opportunities, zero scheduled, pointing to a gap in the intake and follow-up process.
watch_item.fix: Attribution and contact cleanup are in progress now, and the full lead-to-patient tracking dashboard is being built for delivery by August 31 so every lead is accountable.
